Shape per plate: must_flag, may_flag, must_not_flag (each {item, kind, value, clear}; item is a core item of gold_labels.json, byte for byte except that ' <long dash> ' is written ', '), if_listed (flags required ONLY when the model lists that OPTIONAL item; no recall credit), note.
